thread:
isabel: hey team -- first day! quick map request: who owns/model-serving vs infra vs security escalations? also who do I ask for dev-gpu access, runbook perms, and PagerDuty add?

noah: welcome :wave: short map: eng-runtime = model process & crashes; eng-platform = rollout/config gates; eng-sre = nodes/k8s/network; eng-security = data/privacy.

tara: process note: if it's a model crash or inference error -> page eng-runtime. If pods/nodes are failing or kube control-plane issues -> page eng-sre. If rollout misconfig -> eng-platform. Security issues -> page eng-security immediately (don't paste sensitive logs).

isabel: who signs off on dev-gpu and PagerDuty? any onboarding checklist I should follow?

people-ops-bot: Access flow: manager approves -> people-ops triages -> infra grants role. Submit: https://redwood.internal/access-request (choose "dev-gpu"). PagerDuty additions require manager sign-off + completion of shadow shifts (3 lightweight oncall shadows) and the new-hire oncall checklist: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall/new-hire-checklist.md.

eli: tiny escalation cheat I keep on my laptop:
```
1) Detect -> post to #incidents + tag primary on-call (runtime or sre)
2) 0-7m: primary expected to ack and triage
3) 7-15m: escalate to secondary + add an incident channel
4) 15m+: call incident commander & exec on-call
Security: short-circuit and page eng-security immediately
```

noah: add'l: ownership matrix is in the handbook: https://redwood.internal/handbook/ownership-matrix. Runbooks: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/inference and /runbooks/platform/rollouts. If you lack repo perms, attach your access-request link in the ticket and people-ops will expedite.

isabel: nice. how do rollbacks work in urgent cases?

tara: prefix the Slack thread with "rollback" and tag eng-platform; our rollout bot will post the checklist and lock further deploys. For hotfixes, page eng-runtime + eng-platform and say "shadowing new hire" if you need guidance.

pagerduty-bot: Note: eng-sre rota update scheduled for 2026-10-01. Check: https://redwood.internal/oncall-calendar

isabel: perfect, thanks! submitting the access form and will ask my manager for the shadow shifts. appreciate the quick map :)
